reason: The frozen Binance CMS catalog pagination route produced only technical HTTP failures (first invalid pageSize=100, then HTTP 429 rate limiting) before any presample market price, return, PnL, or trade outcome was opened. Replace brute-force catalog pagination with a finite canonical article-code seed and validate every seed against the official Binance article-detail CMS endpoint. This is a source-route repair only.
source_authority_unchanged: Official Binance Support announcement detail content remains the final inclusion authority.

technical_route.seed_role: Discovery aid only. Each unique article code MUST be fetched from the official Binance public article-detail CMS endpoint and independently validated before market data may be opened.
validation_requirements: All integers 1..30 appear exactly once across seed project_numbers
Official detail response is retrievable and preserved byte-for-byte
Official detail content identifies Binance Launchpool
Official detail content contains staking/locking/farming semantics
Expected token symbol(s) are present in official content
Original official publishDate/releaseDate is extracted from detail response
No market-price source is touched until all source validation passes
technical_route.combined_announcement_rule: A single official article may canonically cover multiple numbered Launchpool projects. Such an article is fetched once and expands to project-level source records sharing the same canonical publication timestamp and raw-response hash.

forbidden: Adding or deleting a numbered project after seeing BNBBTC outcomes
Changing side, hold, costs, cluster rule, pair, or gates
Using any market-price result to adjudicate source inclusion
Opening another historical rescue if this final holdout fails
